# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 49 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 49 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_049_page_001.jpg

---

## Mandate 12, Part 6 — Keep These Twelve Commandments

**49:1** "These twelve commandments must be kept and observed, Hermas. But above everything else — keep faith. If you hold onto faith, you will be able to keep all the rest. And I will show you who are the servants entrusted with these commandments, so you understand that I'm not adding anything of my own here. These truly are God's commandments."

**49:2** "The twelve commandments must be kept. When someone who has faith in the Lord keeps these commandments, they will receive a tremendous reward from the Lord — life in the age to come. But the person who doesn't keep them will face death, because the way they live doesn't allow them to live at all."

**49:3** "Everyone who clings to evil desire will stay stuck in the miserable condition they're already in. But those who give up evil desire and clothe themselves in good desire — they will receive life from the Lord. Because every good desire points toward life, and every evil desire points toward death."

**49:4** "I also say this: hold on to good desire and maintain it — don't let it slip away. It is strong and powerful. Keep it with everything you have, because it leads to life. But if you hold on to evil desire instead, understand that it leads to death — as I've already explained to you."

**49:5** "These twelve commandments were given to you, Hermas, so that you would understand: these words come from me and are not a human being's words — they are the words of the Lord God. I have the authority to give commandments like these. Keep them and you will live."

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, capturing the authoritative close of the Mandates section.*
